policy.authority: pdoom-data is the authority on taxonomy for real-time events and owns the structure of the editorial layer, ruled by Pip 2026-08-06 (coordination#31 Phase 2).
policy.boundary: Taxonomy authority is not shaping authority. This repo defines what a term means; it does not define what a consumer does with it.
policy.status_meaning: 'proposed' terms have not been ruled by anyone. Do not build a contract on a proposed term without saying so.
policy.ownership: minted_elsewhere entries are pointers, not definitions. The owning repo's definition governs; this file records only that the term is not ours to change.
